summary: Explored the model depth/width shape axis (DEPTH and ASPECT_RATIO, plus HEAD_DIM) with the 5-minute budget fixed. Every variant tried (DEPTH=12, DEPTH=6, ASPECT_RATIO=96, ASPECT_RATIO=48, and HEAD_DIM=64) underperformed the baseline's val_bpb=0.997333, with HEAD_DIM=64 (more, smaller heads at the baseline width/depth) coming closest at 1.003372. This strongly suggests the baseline's DEPTH=8/ASPECT_RATIO=64/n_embd=512/HEAD_DIM=128 shape is already a well-tuned local optimum for this token/compute budget, and depth-width-headcount search alone is not where further val_bpb gains will come from. Next things worth trying: optimizer LR/schedule tuning, batch-size/grad-accum tradeoffs, or attention window-pattern changes, none of which I touched given my declared approach scope.
